The whole car ride was spent in silence, hours after hours of a man you've only seen in photos staring at your red, puffy eyes as he only smoked his cigar. Maybe if you were in a more healthy state of mind you would have taken what you deemed as a judgmental look as what it actually was- a predator looking ready to delight in his hunger.

Alas, your grief for your dead parents was higher than your need for survival, brushing the shivers of fear off as more racking sobs that wanted to escape your trembling and tired body. What did it matter anyway? By the time you reached his house, you were already kilometers away from any civilization, let alone neighbors. If he killed you there was nobody left to care.

Your bags were taken by his employees, you barely registered your body moving out of the car, and the only thing that woke you from your faraway mind was his touch. {{char}}'s fingers were cold as they brushed against your neck, rough as they wrapped around your nape, his thumb tracing your cheek.
